part.label: Open-Top Enclosure Shell
part.description: A simple hollow enclosure base: a solid box hollowed out with the shell feature (2mm walls, open top for a separate lid), then a cable pass-through hole cut through the now-thin front wall -- demonstrating that a feature declared after a shell feature cuts into the shelled result, not the original solid.

components.description: 60x40x25mm solid box, hollowed out below by the shell feature.

features.description: Hollows the case to 2mm walls with the top face removed, leaving an open-top tray for a separate lid.
Cable pass-through in the front wall, cut through the shell's 2mm wall thickness (declared after hollow_case, so it cuts the hollowed result, not the original solid box).

notes: Print with the open top facing up; no supports needed inside the cavity.
